FIELDS.NAME: Happy Bites Family Diner
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Happy Bites Family Diner is a restaurant located in Springfield, Illinois, offering a family-friendly dining experience with a diverse menu featuring burgers, sandwiches, salads, and desserts. Our operations focus on providing high-quality food in a fast and efficient manner, ensuring a clean and welcoming environment for families. With a seating capacity of 150, we prioritize safety and compliance, adhering strictly to health codes and maintaining all kitchen equipment and fire suppression systems regularly. We also implement rigorous food safety training for our staff, ensuring our entire operation meets the highest standards. In addition, our establishment does not serve alcoholic beverages, which significantly reduces liability risks and simplifies our operations while allowing us to concentrate on exceptional food service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 15, 2023, a slip and fall incident occurred during peak hours, resulting in medical expenses of $1,200. The case was settled out of court with no further claims expected. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, UL Listed Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security cameras installed around the premises for enhanced protection.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in our operations. We focus solely on food service and maintain a clean and safe environment compliant with health codes.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not sponsor any athletic teams. Our focus is primarily on providing a family-friendly dining experience within our restaurant.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our compliance officer, John Smith.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime associated with any applicant connected to this property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Happy Bites Family Diner has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Our previous coverage with NextGen Insurance Solutions was maintained without any issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not lease employees to or from other employers, focusing on a stable workforce for effective service.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Happy Bites Family Diner carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees. We prioritize safety and employee welfare in our operations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on providing a family-friendly dining experience at our restaurant.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Our focus is solely on the current policy with adequate coverage for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Happy Bites Family Diner is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing food service in a family-friendly dining environment.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on providing quality food service within our establishment.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Happy Bites Family Diner has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Our financial records are stable and we maintain compliance with all obligations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in our operations, focusing solely on food service in a safe environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Happy Bites Family Diner does not have any catastrophe exposure as we primarily focus on providing a safe and compliant dining environment without engaging in high-risk operations. Our operations are strictly centered around food service, adhering to safety standards to mitigate risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Happy Bites Family Diner has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize a safe and respectful environment for both employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Happy Bites Family Diner has no uncorrected fire code violations, and we prioritize compliance with all safety regulations. Regular inspections and maintenance are conducted to ensure our fire protection systems are up to standard.
